name: Mysterious Thief Emerald
source:
They call her Mysterious Thief Emerald. Her life is anything but ordinary... and a certain keen-eyed detective seems determined to keep it that way!

[From [url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/mysterious-thief-emerald]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们称她为神秘盗翡翠。她的生活一点也不平凡……而某个目光敏锐的侦探似乎决心让这种生活保持下去！

[来自[url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/mysterious-thief-emerald]Itch.io[/url]]
